paper.title_en: Thermodynamic Representations of Algebraically Modified FLRW Dynamics at the Apparent Horizon
paper.abstract_en: We investigate the thermodynamic description of a general class of algebraically modified Friedmann dynamics in which the physical matter obeys the standard conservation equation and the modification is encoded through a function \(g(ρ)\). By introducing a thermodynamic matter representation \(χ(ρ)\), we construct the corresponding matter variables, heat flow, work term, and horizon entropy, and show that both the Clausius relation and the first-law balance can be consistently maintained. A continuous family of representations is then defined by \(χ_λ(ρ)=(1-λ)ρ+λg(ρ)\) with \(0\leqλ\leq1\), and the physical-matter and effective-fluid descriptions as the two endpoints. The associated thermodynamic quantities transform consistently between these limits. We further show that apparent departures from equilibrium can arise from mixing quantities belonging to different representations, rather than from a genuine non-equilibrium entropy-production mechanism. These results identify a continuous freedom of thermodynamic representation within this class of modified FLRW dynamics.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 论文探讨修正FLRW动力学在视界处的热力学描述，涉及第一定律与视界熵，属于黑洞/视界热力学范畴；理论构造较深入，但方法细节与结果在摘要中信息有限，新颖性中等。
decision.title_zh: 视界处代数修正FLRW动力学的热力学表示
decision.abstract_zh: 我们研究一类一般性代数修正Friedmann动力学的热力学描述，其中物理物质服从标准守恒方程，而修正通过一个函数 \(g(ρ)\) 编码。通过引入热力学物质表示 \(χ(ρ)\)，我们构造相应的物质变量、热流、功项和视界熵，并表明Clausius关系与第一定律的平衡关系均可被一致地保持。随后，我们通过 \(χ_λ(ρ)=(1-λ)ρ+λg(ρ)\)（其中 \(0\leqλ\leq1\)）定义了一个连续表示族，物理物质描述与有效流体描述作为其两个端点。相关的热力学量在这些极限之间一致地变换。我们进一步表明，表观上的偏离平衡可能源自混合属于不同表示的物理量，而非源自真正的非平衡熵产生机制。这些结果在这类修正FLRW动力学中识别出一种热力学表示的连续自由度。
